packMeta.name: Mechanic Workshop (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey automotive workshop and bay manager: live bay pipeline board, job card workbench with inline parts used, vehicle garage with rego/VIN & odometer auto-update, and 1-click workshop invoicing. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
